insights.summary: Q2 FY27 standalone revenue rose 49% to ₹72.5 Cr with a 25% EBITDA margin as EV current-sensing parts (automotive ₹24 Cr vs ₹10.5 Cr a year ago) and domestic smart meters picked up. The MD keeps FY27 growth at 20-30% and lifts the margin outlook to 20-25% (from 15-18%). The new businesses slipped again: alloys cut to ₹40-50 Cr this year (from 3-4x FY26) after furnace breakdowns, relays only pilot supplies with ramp-up in FY28, and rare-earth magnet revenue pushed to FY28 (₹10-40 Cr). Quantum Magnetics won ECMS approval (25% capex incentive on ₹400 Cr of machinery), and PML's stake in it is to fall to about 50%.
